title: Cool Tumbler!
text: Cool Tumbler!. This summer  I started using large tumblers with straws for my water. They have been fun to use and I have been drinking a lot more water. This cup is pretty cool. It has a metallic black/silver color to it. The quality is good. I do think it's a bit pricey. I can go to my favorite chain coffee shop and purchase one of their cups for a little less!
